components: an upper square frame ending in a short middle bar
strokeOrder: start at the middle left and climb the left upright
without lifting, carry the top bar to the right and return along it to the inner corner
without lifting, drop the inner upright and carry the middle bar right — then lift once
set the pen at the inner crossing, curve down and around the lower-left bowl, return up its outer left side, and close the bowl at the crossing — and only now lift
strokeOrderNote: two strokes — three joined upper-frame movements, one lift, then the lower-left bowl; cited to Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Frame 3, ச

strokeOrderSource.citation: Sankaran Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Appendix I: Hand-movements, Frame 3, ச (University of Texas at Austin), p. 191
strokeOrderSource.variation: Frame 3 numbers the three joined upper-frame movements before the separate fourth movement turns around ச's lower-left bowl. Tamil handwriting varies by school; this is one attested two-run order fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Tamil outline.

notes: Ca is the simpler sibling of க: both begin with the same upper frame, but ச keeps only the rounded lower-left bowl and lets the middle bar project to the right. The final movement closes that bowl back at the crossing. The numbered movements form two pen-down runs, not four separate strokes.
